title: A map of sheaves which is an isomorphism off finitely many closed points is an isomorphism on H^q, q >= 2
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme with inclusion $j:U\to X$, and assume that $X\setminus U$ is a finite set of closed points [def-weil-closed-points] $x$ each of whose residue fields $\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is separably closed [def-kun-separably-closed]. Let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a morphism of abelian sheaves on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] such that $j^{-1}\varphi$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is an isomorphism. Then $H^q(\varphi):H^q(X_{\Et},F)\to H^q(X_{\Et},G)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] is bijective for every $q\ge2$.
